* Un bureau branché au cœur de Montréal


 Votre développement professionnel est notre priorité. Grâce à un crédit annuel de 1500 CAD développement professionnel, vous êtes encouragés à continuer d’apprendre, à explorer de nouvelles compétences et à progresser dans votre carrière. Nous voulons que vous vous épanouissiez, que vous progressiez et que vous vous sentiez épanoui tout en travaillant sur des tâches importantes. Rejoignez\-nous et aidez\-nous à construire un avenir meilleur pour les villes du monde entier.
   

  

 Notre engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l'inclusion
   

  

 Nous visons à constituer une équipe diversifiée et une culture d'entreprise inclusive. Nous sommes un employeur souscrivant au principe de l'égalité des chances et ne pratiquons aucune discrimination fondée sur la race, la couleur, l'appartenance ethnique, l'ascendance, l'origine nationale, la religion, le sexe, l'identité ou l'expression sexuelle, l'orientation sexuelle, l'âge, le handicap, le statut de vétéran, les informations génétiques, l'état matrimonial ou tout autre statut protégé par la loi.

You will join a strong Data Intelligence team of Data Engineers, Data Analysts and a Data Scientist, while partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Commerical and other functions to solve meaningful business problems.  In your role, you will be expected to liaise with both customers and engineers and will need to be able to explain the methods and results of your work to people with varying levels of data science experience. Continuous learning and a thirst for knowledge are expected as you maintain your knowledge of both our abilities and the state of the art possibilities, blending the best of what the data science community has on offer.  Further information can be found at: I’m changing my career \| Australian Signals Directorate (asd.gov.au).
 



  





**Key Duties:** 




**ASD 4 Data Scientist** 




 An ASD 4 Data Scientists, you will work to the broad direction of the executive leadership to perform and achieve complex data generation and analysis work within an integrated workforce. You will require knowledge of compliance with the legislative frameworks, government decision\-making and an understanding of Australian Signals Directorate’s mission.
 



  





 You will be deliberate with the learning of technical and analytical skills and proactive with communicating with their team and leadership. You will exercise sound decision\-making to provide technical advice and in line with direction, will engage in complex problem solving to deliver data science solutions that affect strategic, political or operational outcomes for the Australian Signals Directorate.
 



  





 You will positively contribute to building team capability and will be accountable to contribute towards ongoing self\-improvement and professional development for their career.
 



  





**ASD 5 Data Scientist** 




 An ASD 5 Data Scientist will work under limited direction to perform and achieve complex data generation and analysis work within an integrated workforce. You are accountable to have and maintain a well\-developed understanding of compliance to relevant legislative frameworks, government decision\-making and the Australian Signals Directorate’s mission and policy requirements.
 



  





 You will be accountable for organising your workflow and making independent decisions relating to their area of responsibility. You will interpret and provide advice within the data function area based on legislation, policy and procedures. You will undertake research and analysis, conduct investigations and perform data generation and analysis work to achieve results.
 



  





 You may coordinate and contribute to the work of a team and provide advice and assistance on methods of task completion to team members. You may be a team coach and are expected to be capable of reviewing and developing the quality of work undertaken by others and identifying opportunities for on\-the\-job training within a work unit.
 



  





 As a Data Scientist, you will be required to engage and communicate with stakeholders to respond and provide advice on issues to mission outcomes. You will be accountable to contribute towards ongoing self\-improvement and professional development.
 



  





**ASD 6 Data Scientist** 




 An ASD 6 Data Scientist is accountable, under the broad direction of the executive leadership, to perform and achieve complex to very complex data generation and analysis work within an integrated workforce. You will require knowledge of compliance with legislative frameworks, government decision\-making and strong understanding of Australian Signals Directorate’s mission.
 



  





 You will exercise a degree of independence and perform a subject matter expert role. You will exercise sound decision making and judgement to provide strong technical advice. Engage in complex to very complex problem solving and issue management and may coordinate and contribute to detailed or sensitive projects that impact on strategic, political or operational outcomes for the Australian Signals Directorate.
 



  





 You may be a Line Manager and mentor, and will be accountable for the outcomes of the planning for work and performance goals. You are expected to be capable of building team capability through coaching, feedback and developing the quality of work undertaken by others within a work unit.
 



  





 As a Data Scientist, you will be involved in key stakeholder relationships and will be required to identify relevant stakeholders’ expectations and concerns to develop and communicate methodologies and practices to achieve outcomes. You will be accountable to contribute towards ongoing self\-improvement and professional development of their work area.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 Data scientist roles within Mission Data Division (MDD) develops capabilities and data solutions to enable ASD mission areas, to support ASD and ADF mission requirements.
 



  





 This is achieved through the delivery of data platforms, ensuring the data is fit for purpose, delivering bespoke mission tools and applications, and providing complex analytic support, including Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence capability.
 



  





 As part of your job, ASD will support you and provide opportunities to stay up\-to\-date with the latest trends and technologies to develop new ways to collect information and solve intelligence problems. The work we do is unique, critical and incredibly rewarding.

 Our ideal candidate has a thirst for learning and an ability to convince data to tell its story. They can have industry experience, formal training or a particular domain expertise but regardless of this, they must have strong critical thinking and reasoning and be able to demonstrate this through the selection process. At the core of their skills is an understanding of the fundamentals of data or geospatial analysis and/or data science. Our ideal candidate embraces diversity and is willing to approach problems from a cross disciplinary perspective. They have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to ask the right questions. Most importantly, they need to enjoy working as part of a dynamic team to solve interesting problems.

Als Data Analyst bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Programmierung, Statistik und kritischem Denken. Dein Aufgabenspektrum:

* Du validierst Leistungsprognosen mit bereits vorhandenen Statistik\- und Analyse\-Tools.
* Prozessanalyse: Zur inhaltlichen und operativen Weiterentwicklung unseres Vorhersagesystems setzt du jeweils passende Data\-Science\-Methoden ein, deckst interne Prozess\-Schwachstellen auf und entwickelst Konzepte zur Optimierung.
* Zudem wirkst du bei internen und externen Projekten, u. a. zur Bereitstellung statistikrelevanter Daten, mit und übernimmst das Projektmanagement.
* Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Teams aus Meteorologie, Forschung und Softwareentwicklung zusammen.


**Dein Profil:**


* Du hast dein ingenieur\- oder naturwissenschaftliches Studium in Data Science / Analytics, Mathematik, (Geo\-)Physik, Meteorologie oder in einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen.

* Für dich ist Datenanalyse ein bisschen wie Detektivarbeit: Du suchst gern nach Hinweisen, die dich zum Kern führen und setzt dich mit komplexen Sachverhalten auseinander – dazu bringst du Analysestärke mit, um vielschichtige Prozesse zu verstehen und zu hinterfragen.
* Auch in zeitkritischen Phasen können wir uns auf deinen engagierten Einsatz verlassen. Auch über die Kernarbeitszeit hinaus stehst du deinem Team zur Seite und hast das Ziel stets im Fokus.
* Du kommunizierst teamorientiert und fühlst dich sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch sicher, weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
* Wir freuen uns über Zusatzwissen zu erneuerbaren Energien, Energiemärkten oder numerischen Wettervorhersagen und vielleicht hast du ja sogar schon ein Wettermodell aufgesetzt – du lernst jedenfalls immer gern dazu.

* Du erhältst die Chance, an sinnstiftenden Projekten im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien mitzuarbeiten und dein Potenzial sowie deine Ideen einzubringen.
* Dein Arbeitstag ist abwechslungsreich, deine Tätigkeit anspruchsvoll und dein Team motiviert.

* Flexible Arbeitszeit und die Erfassung jeder Überstunde: Du musst nicht um 7 Uhr auf der Matte stehen. Wichtig ist uns, dass du vollen Einsatz zeigst, wenn du da bist.

* Design and prototype advanced electronic circuitry for handheld and wearable sensor devices targeting early detection, monitoring and prevention of health conditions.

* Collaborate with data scientists to interface hardware with AI and ML algorithms.

* Proficiency in analogue, digital, and mixed\-signal circuit design, including experience with microwave and RF components for sensing and communications.
* Experience in conducting experimental validation and iterative development of technological solutions
* Experience using electronic design automation (EDA) tools namely Eagle and laboratory instrumentation for circuit testing and characterisation
* Strong track record of publishing research in peer\-reviewed journals or writing industrial reports
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present findings clearly to diverse audiences

* A collaborative and team\-oriented approach to work.

* Effective time management skills and the ability to prioritise

**The perks of being at Answer**

At Answer we proudly embrace diversity and inclusion \- we want to create a safe environment for everyone to bring their true selves to work.

 **Our Interview Process**


We pride ourselves on having a fair but flexible recruitment process, we want to create a platform where you can show us your best. For us, keeping it simple means you can focus on understanding if our people, values and the work we do are right for you. Our typical process can be broken down into 3 stages;

* **Application Process:** Depending on the volume of applications, our process may involve a couple of assessments. We focus on your inherent ability rather than your CV.
* **Recruiter call:** This will be with a member of the recruitment team, and normally lasts 15\-30 minutes. We will talk to you about Answer Digital, the type of work we do, and an overview of the role. We’ll ask you some questions about your current situation and why you’re interested in working here. Here, we'd advise asking any questions about our people, such as our culture, career progression, or approach to flexible working.
* **Skills based interview:** This interview will be with 2 people, normally from the team you’re applying to work with and roughly lasts an hour. This interview will involve questions around your experience, the skills you’ve gained and the work you’ve done. We’ll also ask questions about the role and challenges you might face and how you’d face them. Here, we’d recommend asking questions about the role, the day to day responsibilities and what life in the team is like.
* **Cultural/Value interview:** The final interview stage is an hour\-long discussion with two members of our Leadership team (either Directors or Capability Leads). This interview is a two\-way conversation, as much about you assessing if Answer is the right fit for you as it is about us assessing your fit with Answer. The focus will be on our culture and values. We'll discuss what our values mean to us, and we want to understand what values are important to you and how you like to work. title: Principal AI Program Manager
description:
**Role Overview:**  

We are seeking an experienced and forward\-thinking Principal AI Program Manager to lead the design, development, and deployment of cutting\-edge AI solutions for our clients. In this senior consulting role, you will combine deep technical expertise with client\-facing leadership, driving innovation through GenAI while maintaining a strong foundation across broader AI/ML and full\-stack engineering. You will architect scalable, secure, production\-grade AI systems, support pre\-sales engagements, and play a pivotal role in shaping our growing AI engineering practice.


This is a strategic role for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology, delivery, and client advisory—and who is excited to build the next generation of intelligent applications using GenAI and beyond.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Delivery – Generative AI \& Full\-Stack AI Solutions**

* Lead the delivery of advanced AI applications, with a strong focus on Generative AI (LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering, agents, etc.).
* Architect and implement scalable GenAI systems—combining LLM orchestration, model integration, data pipelines, and secure APIs.
* Work across the full stack, developing intuitive front\-end experiences and robust back\-end services to support AI capabilities.
* Collaborate with client data scientists, product managers, and engineering teams to align solutions with business outcomes.
* Ensure production\-readiness, including performance optimization, observability, security, and maintainability of AI applications.

  

**Key Skills \& Experience:**

* 10\+ years in software engineering, with extensive experience in AI/ML application development and recent hands\-on delivery of GenAI\-based solutions.
* Deep knowledge of Generative AI technologies—LLMs, vector databases, RAG pipelines, prompt design, fine\-tuning, orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, Haystack, Flowise), and cloud GenAI services (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI).
* Full\-stack proficiency including front\-end frameworks (React, Angular) and back\-end (Node.js, Django, Flask) development.
* Strong cloud architecture skills (AWS, GCP, Azure), including MLOps/DevOps experience for deploying and scaling AI solutions in production.
* Proven ability to work with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, translating business requirements into AI solution architecture.
* Domain experience in Insurance is highly desirable
* Experience in consulting or professional services, with strong pre\-sales, proposal writing, and client advisory skills.
* Demonstrated leadership in building teams, scaling delivery, and contributing to IP/assets that grow a consulting practice.
